prompts.name: sign
prompts.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: production Factorio cast-shadow-only sprite layer. Image 1 is the exact object/placement reference, Image 2 is ONLY the native Factorio lighting reference (pole and furnace cast shadows). Generate the CAST SHADOWS ONLY of the objects in Image 1. REMOVE all colored objects and output only their projected black ground shadows, on a genuinely transparent alpha=0 background. No backdrop, floor, checkerboard, labels, light gray rectangle, object render, highlights, arrows drawn inside shadows, or gradients. All visible shadow RGB must be pure black, opaque silhouette interiors with only a tiny antialiased edge; the game supplies final shadow opacity. Match the vanilla reference: fixed sun from screen LEFT, casting predominantly screen RIGHT/east, virtually horizontal, only slight perspective spreading. Shadows must lie flat on the ground; do NOT simply fill the tall upright sprite black. Do NOT rotate the light source when rotating an object. Preserve Image 1's EXACT canvas layout, relative object scales, projected ground contact/feet positions and quadrant positions. Each shadow begins under the precise feet/base of its corresponding source object. Leave ample transparent margins. Image 1 is a 768x768 atlas, four 384x384 cells: top left north-facing tall pole sign, top right east-facing, bottom left south-facing, bottom right west-facing. In each cell the world ground origin is x=96,y=272, and the tall sign artwork extends upward from its foot base there. Draw a long, thin eastward pole shadow on the ground, ending in the flattened rectangular sign-board silhouette and small cap/fitting silhouettes. Cast length approximately 210 source pixels from feet to farthest fitting, like the vanilla pole of comparable height. The broad sign board's projection differs correctly for each orientation; the post never stands upright in the shadow. Preserve feet contacts exactly and return one shadow in each existing cell, no other objects.
